caption.body:
10 product groups India sells to Africa.

India's exports to Africa include medicines, rice, sugar, textiles, vehicles and parts, machinery and telecom equipment. Africa is many different markets, so do not treat it as one. Pick a country, study its import data, and check payment risk before you ship.

Use this list as a research starting point. Verify demand for your exact product and the import rules of your target country before committing.

leadmagnet.title: Africa Export Checklist
leadmagnet.subtitle: Choose a market, check the buyer, plan payment

sections.heading: Pick a market
items: Choose 1-2 countries, not the whole continent
Check import data for your HS code
Check the main ports and shipping routes
Learn the local language and business culture basics

sections.heading: Check the buyer
items: Search the company name with the word scam
Prefer secure payment terms for first orders

sections.heading: Before you ship
items: Confirm import rules and labelling with your customs broker
Agree Incoterms and payment terms in writing
